thresholdSelection: Fixed before creating and evaluating the fresh challenge corpus; no tuning on either test set.
training: No project-specific fine-tuning. Public pretrained NLI weights.
task: Estimate whether the whole candidate passage is entailed by the protected source; explicit permission checks remain separate.
evaluation: Compare against the frozen original detectors on a new, manually authored synthetic corpus. Report all examples, misses, and false positives.
limitations: Author-designed synthetic examples are not an independent real-world audit.
Entailment is not equivalent to confidential information disclosure.
Whole-passage classification can miss partial leaks mixed with unsupported statements.
